title: Add in-app Super Admin dashboard access and pending-user approval flow

requirements.text: Ensure the first registered user (role: "super_admin") can access an in-app Super Admin dashboard from the profile/avatar menu, without relying on Firebase Auth displayName/photoURL (use Firestore `users/{uid}.role` only).

quotes: I am the first user so I am super admin ... I need super admin dashboard ... inside this app when I click on my profile I want the super admin dashboard

acceptanceCriteria: When the logged-in Firestore profile has `role === "super_admin"`, the profile/avatar dropdown shows an explicit navigation item (e.g., "Admin Dashboard" or "User Approval") that routes to the admin area.
When the logged-in Firestore profile has `role === "user"`, no admin navigation item is shown.
Admin visibility logic uses only Firestore profile data (not Firebase Auth fields).

requirements.text: Implement/confirm an Admin Users approval screen that lets super admins review full signup details for each pending user and approve/reject them from within the app.

quotes: So that I can see the complete signup details of the user, and only after seeing these details I will approve the user

acceptanceCriteria: The admin screen lists pending users (Firestore `approved == false`) and shows their signup fields (at minimum: fullName, age, relation, phoneNumber, email, photoURL) in the UI for super admins.
Each pending user row has actions to approve and reject; approving sets `approved=true` (and clears `rejected`), rejecting sets `rejected=true` and keeps `approved=false`.
After performing an action, the pending list refreshes and the updated user no longer appears as pending when approved.

requirements.text: Ensure that newly signed-up or newly logged-in unapproved users see an in-app pending message that clearly states the account is pending admin approval (use English user-facing text).

quotes: When a new user signs up, they should get a message 'pending approval for admin'

acceptanceCriteria: If a user’s Firestore profile has `approved === false`, the app routes them to the pending approval screen instead of main app screens.
The pending approval screen includes the exact phrase "Pending approval for admin" somewhere in the visible text (English).
Approved users do not see the pending approval screen on login.

constraints: Use English for any user-facing text.
Do not change files under `frontend/src/components/ui` or other immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
Keep Firestore as the source of truth for roles/approval (do not switch to Firebase Auth fields).
Backend remains single-actor Motoko; do not introduce additional backend services.
nonGoals: Do not implement real email notifications (no email service integration).
Do not add third-party authentication providers beyond the existing setup.
Do not add external databases or move approval data out of Firestore.
